guard.note: tick: super.tick; frosty particles; then if (!hasFluff() && !isBaby()) { fluffGrowTime > 0 ? fluffGrowTime-- : setFluff(true) } (the wrapped hasFluff call is the only one in tick)
declared methods: fluffGrowTime is used only by the constructor (18000 + random 6000), tick, save / load and onSheared
setFluff(false); fluffGrowTime = 18000 + random 6000: the only reset of the timer
onSyncedDataUpdated reacts only to DATA_BOOST_TIME (client steering), then super
Forge's interactLivingEntity: an IForgeShearable on a client level returns SUCCESS before onSheared, so the client never resets its copy of the timer

snuffles_fluff_regrow_server_only.conversion: Fix: MixinExtras @ModifyExpressionValue on the hasFluff() call guarding the regrow block of Snuffle.tick answers true on a client level (helper bons.furious.patch.snuffles_coo49.SnufflesCoo49, flag snufflesFluffRegrowServerOnly): the client neither counts its unsynced regrow timer down nor writes DATA_FLUFF; server levels run the original

guard.note: bodyParts: ImmutableList.of(body, rightFrontLeg, leftFrontLeg, rightHindLeg, leftHindLeg) (the redirected call)
the five parts are private final fields set here

snuffles_model_parts_reuse.conversion: Exact variant: @Redirect of the ImmutableList.of call in SnuffleModel.bodyParts; the model keeps the list (a @Unique field) and returns it while its five elements are the very parts asked for (identity), else a new list as the original (helper bons.furious.patch.snuffles_coo49.SnufflesCoo49, flag snufflesModelPartsReuse)
snuffles_model_parts_reuse.license: MIT (Snuffles): no Snuffles code is carried; the redirect returns a kept list of the same parts
